data.short_meaning: One devoted to worship; one who retreats in a mosque (iʿtikāf)
data.long_meaning: Aakif (عاكف) is the active participle of the Arabic ʿakafa, 'to stay, to devote oneself'. In Islamic usage it denotes a person performing iʿtikāf — withdrawing to a mosque for a period of worship. It means 'devoted to worship; one who stays in retreat'.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name points to devoted worship and retreat; any further spiritual reading is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Active participle of Arabic ʿakafa, 'to stay, to devote oneself'; cf. iʿtikāf.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aakif total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aakif mean?
faq.a: Aakif means One devoted to worship; one who retreats in a mosque (iʿtikāf).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aakif?
What language does the name Aakif come from?
faq.a: Aakif is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aakif a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aakif is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aakif written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aakif is written عاكف in Arabic and عاکف in Urdu, and आकिफ़ in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aakif?
faq.a: The root of Aakif is ع-ك-ف (ʿ-k-f).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aakif?
faq.a: Active participle of Arabic ʿakafa, 'to stay, to devote oneself'; cf. iʿtikāf.

faq.q: Does Aakif appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not itself a Qur'anic personal name; the root ʿ-k-f and the practice of iʿtikāf are Islamic.
Iʿtikāf is the Islamic practice of withdrawing to a mosque for a period of worship; a person who does so is called ʿākif, the meaning behind the name Aakif.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aakif?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aakif total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aakif?
faq.a: Aakif appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Akif, Aakifah.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aakif?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aakif include Aakifah, Aakil.
It is the active participle of ʿakafa, 'to stay, to devote oneself', hence 'one who devotes himself to worship'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aakif used today?
faq.a: Aakif is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
